method: Presentation bands are provisional local expert prioritization using inspected current source and saved390px and320px dark/enlarged views. They are neither actual acceptance scores nor player perception, retention or value measurements. Functional passes alone do not establish premium quality, emotional reward or9.5 global acceptance.
currentSourceImprovements: Rating-card evidence copy no longer repeats Developing; genuine personal best and confirmed-result count are adjacent to the main estimate.
All eight original league seals now include the authored shuttle mark and differentiated silhouettes/material treatment.
Published reveal, promotion and personal-best states have distinct earned headings and a direct Home share action; special entrance runs once per revision per visit with optional replay.
Compact result score/player layout and the rating replay container have been refined.
Public-link transient loading errors remain distinct from unavailable/revoked links and support visible retry; share privacy changes clear a previously created link.

Appearance controls remain usable with blocked browser storage; settings availability and mutable pending actions have explicit recovery/freeze behavior. Completed run evidence is recorded separately in the persona matrix.
Ambiguous passkey creation/removal now hides actionable stale key state until an authoritative read; the virtual-authenticator interrupted-response regression passed in the65-case run.
Account choices now have a compact scoped draft notice and a sticky Save action inspected above phone navigation; preferred category explicitly applies immediately on this device.
Prior-consent result review directly requests one eligible opponent; only retrospective all-player consent retains the full-roster denominator.
Unearned/unknown Gem state renders a neutral placeholder rather than an invented league.
Completed account-boundary and expired-session cases check modal/late-completion isolation, fresh identity verification, pending intent retention and matching-account recovery-code activation.

Profile settings explicitly explain existing automatic all-link revocation when public name or area is turned off. Active private entries show actual template, captured name/area and timestamps; selective fresh-link revocation and automatic withdrawal passed full69. Repeated-read guards and authoritative successful-mutation refresh passed full70.

Recent earned result now follows the rating guide before comparable-friend context in the inspected default Home. Genuine best, reveal and promotion use different factual before/after evidence rather than invented milestone progress.

A chosen accepted friend stays visible even when direct comparison is unsupported; automatic choice is labelled Closest comparable friend, with concrete placement/pending/partner-linked next actions. Weekly recap failed versus empty states have explicit Retry.

A new server-authoritative published promotion snapshot is implemented end-to-end and its historical public/PNG export passed representative reward-context checks in full69. Promotion export was absent before this work, rather than a reachable generic-label fallback.

Post-full70 compact Home recaps now state only the real won/lost outcome below their numeric/delta/peak block; full result reviews retain before/after and model context. Small best cards remove the redundant transition arrow and reduce spacing. These latest presentation edits passed the rebuilt affected11 checks; final compact Home/best captures have now been inspected with their bundle/hash provenance.

Routine Home result uses a compact published-rating line, actual delta and outcome; special reveal/best/promotion and full review remain distinct. A genuine Arena label contrast regression was detected and received a specific color fix; final frozen-source full70 passed, including its accessibility case.

opportunities.finding: The fresh phone passport has coherent forest/ivory typography, strong number hierarchy and original shuttle-bearing league seals. The overall restrained dashboard composition still needs independent sporting recognition and premium desirability evidence; creator connection is mainly attribution.
opportunities.implementationCandidate: Inspect the authored sporting composition consistently across current results and exports. Integrate useful creator-approved guidance when supplied, without inventing editorial endorsement or photos; evaluate the refined identity with actual players before treating premium perception as accepted.
opportunities.requires: Current-state visual inspection and independent recognition/desirability evidence.

opportunities.finding: The final Home view puts latest published earned context directly below the main rating guide, before friend comparison. Current estimate, confirmed count, personal best and genuine dated reward are distinct; enlarged final review preserves all sides/score/time through scrolling. Actual unassisted comprehension is still absent.
opportunities.implementationCandidate: Retain the current hierarchy and truthful contextual disclosure. Inspect future long-name, losing, empty, pending and mixed states before making layout-wide claims; measure unassisted task comprehension separately.
opportunities.requires: Inspected empty, developed, winning, losing, pending, long-name and enlarged-text states; unassisted comprehension remains separate.

opportunities.finding: Current source and final views differentiate reveal, personal best and promotion through actual earned evidence. Historical promotion now has a published dated snapshot, public view and PNG; shared/revisited numbers remain distinct from the current estimate. Actual motion emotion and repeated-use fatigue remain unmeasured.
opportunities.implementationCandidate: Preserve authoritative published numbers and historical context; assess real motion quality, reward strength and fatigue through device/player evidence before scoring emotional outcomes.
opportunities.requires: Current animated device inspection, calibrated league boundaries, player emotion and repeated-use fatigue evidence.

opportunities.finding: Current Home/source uses exact placement count, chosen-versus-automatic comparison, waiting-result, reached-goal and partner-linked next actions. The direct comparison explanation uses actual history limitations rather than a generic promise. First-session and placement-abandonment outcomes remain unmeasured.
opportunities.implementationCandidate: Retain one legitimate action for each actual evidence state and verify new states as they arise. Use scenario teach-back and real rating calibration to assess understanding and first value; do not promise match counts or outcomes.
opportunities.requires: Scenario teach-back, first-session and placement-abandonment evidence; real rating calibration.

opportunities.finding: Current accepted-friend context explicitly identifies automatic closest comparable selection and allows a chosen accepted friend to remain visible when unsupported. Real feed milestone chips and dated player-progress actions improve relevance. Local titles remain disabled; actual rival relevance, sharing pressure and group effects are unmeasured.
opportunities.implementationCandidate: Evaluate chosen-comparison relevance, real lead changes and genuine group density with players. Preserve friendship/group/consent boundaries and avoid unsupported neighborhood crowns.
opportunities.requires: Real coherent-group usefulness, invitation conversion, voluntary sharing, relevance, privacy and pressure evidence. Creator reach does not establish network density.

opportunities.finding: Reached goals now offer a direct category-focused next-target action; Home shows real period facts and explicit weekly recap failure Retry. These inspectable mechanisms provide relevant next steps but do not establish return behavior or quiet-month value.
opportunities.implementationCandidate: Measure actual meaningful return, post-loss/plateau behavior and quiet weeks while preserving break choice and genuine progress; keep notification stubs separate from provider/device delivery.
opportunities.requires: Real D7/D30 observation windows, consented meaningful-return definitions, post-loss/plateau/quiet-period cohorts and actual push delivery.

opportunities.finding: Phone number/seal robustness, bounded requests, exact consent and recovery controls have extensive local checks. Existing automatically indeterminate contrast items, current error-state layouts, actual assistive technology and physical touch/OS text sizing still need distinct evidence.
opportunities.implementationCandidate: Inspect all current states in both themes at narrow/large-text sizes. Resolve ambiguous contrast geometries, verify focus and label meaning, and keep long names, interrupted actions and controls legible. Preserve the new visit-only appearance fallback when storage is denied.
opportunities.requires: Manual contrast decisions and actual VoiceOver/TalkBack/NVDA, physical-device text/touch/timezone/motion checks; local test success is bounded.

opportunities.finding: The current pilot has no paid entitlement distinction or actual price/renewal evidence. Complete rating and social controls do not demonstrate a broad20-dollar monthly recurring benefit.
opportunities.implementationCandidate: Define a coherent future recurring benefit from evidence the platform actually stores, while keeping opponent approval and core social evidence accessible. Separate individual-player and organizer hypotheses. Do not invent coaching diagnoses or payment behavior.
opportunities.requires: Actual value/price and renewal evidence before a broad paid launch. Payment integration138 remains excluded.
